SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*), 1) AS n FROM certificates AS ce JOIN courses AS co ON co.id = ce.course_id WHERE co.category = 'product'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.score >= q.passing_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS pass_rate FROM quiz_attempts AS a JOIN quizzes AS q ON q.id = a.quiz_id JOIN courses AS co ON co.id = q.course_id WHERE NOT a.score IS NULL AND co.category = 'product'

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id), 1) AS n FROM enrollments AS e JOIN courses AS co ON co.id = e.course_id JOIN users AS u ON u.id = e.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE co.category = 'product' AND LOWER(e.status) IN ('active', 'completed')
SELECT ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1) AS avg_rating FROM reviews AS r JOIN enrollments AS e ON e.id = r.enrollment_id JOIN courses AS co ON co.id = e.course_id WHERE r.hidden = 0 AND co.category = 'devops'
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(l.id), 1) AS n FROM lessons AS l JOIN chapters AS ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id JOIN courses AS co ON co.id = ch.course_id WHERE co.category = 'devops'
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*), 1) AS n FROM certificates AS ce JOIN courses AS co ON co.id = ce.course_id WHERE co.category = 'devops'

SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN a.score >= q.passing_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS pass_rate FROM quiz_attempts AS a JOIN quizzes AS q ON q.id = a.quiz_id JOIN courses AS co ON co.id = q.course_id WHERE NOT a.score IS NULL AND co.category = 'devops'

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id), 1) AS n FROM enrollments AS e JOIN courses AS co ON co.id = e.course_id JOIN users AS u ON u.id = e.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE co.category = 'devops' AND LOWER(e.status) IN ('active', 'completed')
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*), 1) AS n FROM reviews WHERE comment LIKE '%course%'
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*), 1) AS n FROM messages WHERE body LIKE '%extension%'
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*), 1) AS n FROM courses WHERE title LIKE 'Intro to %'
SELECT ROUND(id, 1) AS id FROM reviews WHERE comment LIKE '%instructions%'
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*), 1) AS n FROM reviews WHERE comment LIKE '%instructions%' AND hidden = 0
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*), 1) AS n FROM lessons WHERE title LIKE 'Lesson 3%'

SELECT o.course_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders, ROUND(SUM(o.amount - COALESCE(o.refund_amount, 0)), 1) AS net_revenue FROM orders AS o WHERE LOWER(o.status) = 'paid' GROUP BY o.course_id ORDER BY paid_orders DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT id, ROUND((capacity - booked), 1) AS seats_left FROM live_classes WHERE booked < capacity ORDER BY seats_left DESC
SELECT user_id, ROUND(SUM(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS hours FROM study_sessions GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY hours DESC
SELECT enrollment_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS rate FROM progress GROUP BY enrollment_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY rate DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT ch.course_id, ROUND(SUM(l.duration_min) / 60.0, 1) AS hours FROM lessons AS l JOIN chapters AS ch ON ch.id = l.chapter_id GROUP BY ch.course_id HAVING COUNT(l.id) >= 5 ORDER BY hours DESC
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS diff FROM orders

SELECT course_id, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(status) = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS cancel_rate FROM enrollments GROUP BY course_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY cancel_rate DESC
